system.effect:
Prerequisites: One Tapu Major Gift
Daily – Standard Action
Effect: Until the end of the Scene, you gain a +2 bonus to your Overland, Swim, Jump and Power Capabilities. In addition, during that time, your Struggle Attacks and Moves granted by Weapons deal +5 damage and may instead become a specific Type if you so choose, depending on your Patron; Electric for Tapu Koko, Psychic for Tapu Lele, Grass for Tapu Bulu, Water for Tapu Fini, and Fairy for any.
